title: Broken Authentication in Node.js
description: A Node/Express login stores plaintext passwords, weak sessions, and no brute-force protection.

finding.title: Broken Authentication
finding.description: Passwords are stored or compared in plaintext, session tokens are forgeable, and login is not rate limited.
finding.why_dangerous: Credentials and tokens can be replayed or guessed, so identity checks are ineffective.
finding.impact: Account takeover, impersonation, unauthorized data access.
finding.fix: Hash passwords (bcrypt/argon2), generate cryptographically random session tokens with expiry, and add rate limiting.
learning_example: Plaintext compare lets an attacker with DB read recover every password
base64 token of the username is not a secret; anyone can forge it

checklist: Hash passwords with a strong adaptive algorithm (bcrypt/argon2)
Never store or send plaintext secrets
Issue random, signed, expiring session tokens
Add rate limiting and lockout to /login
Rotate secrets and keep them out of code
